verdict.rationale: The only robots evidence is a probe note that data.colorado.gov's robots directive (crawl-delay 1) was honored. That implies a real robots.txt exists on the Socrata open-data surface that serves Colorado business-entity data. Nothing shows a robots.txt on the primary coloradosos.gov registry or filing site. Missing for 10: evidence of a robots.txt on coloradosos.gov itself, documented allow/disallow rules covering the business search and filing pages, and independent corroboration beyond a passing probe remark.
